Falrin agrees to help prepare an enchantment that can draw Theldren into a fight; his anger at the ogres is personal, rooted in the death of his brother. The required collection is a task in play, not a separate historical episode. What matters to the story is that an old bond supplies the means for a dangerous meeting.

events.name: Ysida in the Slaughter House

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: The way leads through Stratholme to its Slaughter House, where Rivendare holds Ysida. The walls are steeped in the Scourge’s greenish corruption, but the quest’s purpose is rescue: reach her alive and bring her beyond the Baron’s reach. The art marks the room as an interpretation of the Classic dungeon, not a measured reconstruction. Ysida has endured the city’s horror; the next journey carries a message toward the husband she believes is lost.

events.name: Mea Culpa, Lord Valthalak

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: In the Beast’s chamber, the brazier calls Valthalak back into a body that can be confronted. After the battle, the restored amulet is used on his corpse and his spirit appears, whole again. He recognizes that the seeker was not among the original thieves and demands his property back. The quest does not give the mortal a new claim to the medallion; it asks the traveler to return it to its owner and carry his answer back to Bodley.

events.name: Anthion’s parting words

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: With the top piece returned, Anthion explains the danger that he could not see before. The Veiled Blade split Valthalak’s amulet into three parts out of greed, not knowing that it held much of the warlock’s soul. The curse followed. Anthion asks the seeker to find Bodley, who can guide the search for the other pieces. At last, Anthion believes he may rest; his part in the company’s wrong has become a plea to set it right.

events.name: Proof of life

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: Ysida gives the rescuer her locket to carry back to Anthion. She believes he perished while trying to save her, and the token is her proof that she remains alive. When the message reaches the roadside ghost, Anthion learns that the rescue succeeded. Their reunion is brief and divided by death, yet Ysida’s survival releases him from the fear that held him there. He can now offer help in the work that remains.

events.name: Safe for now

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: Valthalak tells the traveler to return to the Veiled Blade and say they are safe—for now. Bodley is astonished that the spirit will call off his assassins, though the promise carries a warning of future harm. The manual still speaks of echoes at the haunted loci, and the company itself has not been restored. Its members remain scattered among separate lives and deaths. What is repaired is the amulet, and for this moment, the pursuit it unleashed.

events.name: The brazier is prepared

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: Bodley prepares a brazier able to call the spirit from its old lair. The chain asks for specific components, but their collection is not another history of the company. Its purpose is to attune the brazier and make the final encounter possible. The manual names haunted places to give the wider meaning: Valthalak’s power has marked the places where his former companions fell, and the Beast’s chamber remains the last of those sites.

events.name: The company flees the risen spirit

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: Valthalak rose as a spirit and called spectral assassins against the mercenaries. Their struggle also roused defenders in the Spire. Most of the Veiled Blade escaped, but safety proved brief: the assassins pursued them wherever they hid. The company soon broke apart, its quarrel made worse by a curse that followed each shard. In the confusion Mor Grayhoof fell toward the lower reaches of the fortress, where his own path would end.

events.name: A fragment taken by Theldren

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: Anthion’s next account turns from rescue to the Veiled Blade’s spoils. The company did not understand the medallion’s importance, so it was divided with their other plunder. A dwarf named Theldren took the first piece. Anthion tried to win it back and was beaten badly; the fragment would have to be claimed through another challenge. The amulet is already more than an ornament, though its danger has not yet been named.

events.name: The former general of the Spire

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: Before Drakkisath, Lord Valthalak was a drakonid noble and warlock who had served as Blackrock Spire’s general. The Veiled Blade entered the upper fortress, slew him, and took the spellbook. Bodley recalls that the company knew too little of Valthalak’s power over souls to understand what they had disturbed. The lair is now called the Beast’s chamber. The manual’s account makes clear that the company’s successful contract was the beginning of its ruin.

events.name: The ghost at Stratholme’s gate

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: At the Eastern Plaguelands road, a goblin device lets the living hear Anthion Harmon. Death has not quieted his concern: Ysida, his wife, was captured by Baron Rivendare inside Stratholme. Anthion says he tried to reach her and failed. He asks the seeker to finish the rescue. The city rises behind him through bare branches and grey-green haze; within it, the question is simple and terrible—whether Ysida still lives.

events.name: The medallion in Kormok’s hands

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: When the company prepared to leave with the book, Kormok claimed Valthalak’s amulet as his share. His insistence turned the group against itself. They argued, nearly came to blows, and finally broke the medallion into three pieces. Only later did they learn that it housed much of Valthalak’s spirit. The distribution followed a lot; Theldren’s top fragment had already returned through Anthion’s challenge, while the other pieces scattered among former companions.

events.name: Finding the other two pieces

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: Bodley guides the search to two further pieces. The quest versions can direct a class or faction branch toward one of several haunted companions; they are alternate targets from the same company history. The four accounts just heard are arranged here as memorials, not as four mandatory kills by one canonical traveler. When the missing pieces are brought together with Theldren’s top fragment, the medallion can be made whole again.

events.name: The Challenge in Blackrock Depths

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: Beneath Blackrock Mountain, the Ring of Law becomes the stage for the challenge. As High Justice Grimstone sentences the intruders, they plant Falrin’s banner. Theldren cannot resist the provocation; he enters the arena with his gladiators. The team composition can vary, so this scene gives no fixed roster or race to the company. The battle retrieves the top piece and changes the next question: now the remaining fragments must be traced to Anthion’s other companions.

events.name: Two doors into the same story

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Dungeon Set 2 questline

events.summary: Deliana speaks from Ironforge; Mokvar speaks from Orgrimmar. Their faction quests are separate doors into the same old wound, not a shared meeting or a single adventurer’s simultaneous allegiance. Each directs a seeker toward Anthion Harmon, whose ghost waits beyond Stratholme. The armor work that frames the journey is only its threshold. Ahead lie a rescue, a company’s last contract, and a medallion whose pieces carried more than any of its owners understood.

events.name: The Dwarven Succession Crisis Opens

date.label: Approximately 230 years before the Dark Portal; working chronology

events.summary: The death of Ironforge's high king broke a tense balance among the Bronzebeard, Wildhammer, and Dark Iron clans and opened a war for the mountain city.

events.name: The Early Troll Powers Rise

date.label: About 16,000 years before the Dark Portal

events.summary: Troll peoples flourished across the forests and jungles of ordered Kalimdor, with the Zandalar, Amani, Gurubashi, and Drakkari among the powers that took shape.

events.name: Azsharite for the weapon

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: A name alone cannot break Razelikh’s hold. The chain next calls for azsharite, a material gathered in Azshara and brought into the weapon-making task. The quest’s collection condition is not retold as a count or a single dramatic excavation. What changes is the preparation: the hunt has found its target, and the seeker now carries material chosen for the Felbane armament that will make the final confrontation possible.

events.name: Bengor brings the lost orders

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: In the Horde telling, Bengor is found wounded in the Swamp of Sorrows. He reports that the dispatch was ambushed and the Warchief’s orders lost. His testimony brings the seeker to Trebor and gives the campaign a practical beginning: before the old soldier can speak of his shame, the missing command must be recovered. The chain does not turn the Alliance introduction into the same journey; it offers another way to reach the shared wound.

events.name: Felbane takes shape

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: At Galvan’s camp in inland Stranglethorn, the material becomes Felbane weaponry. The green canopy, hanging vines and warm air make the setting recognizably different from Azshara’s coast; this is no harbor scene at Booty Bay. Galvan’s part is the transformation of gathered material into a prepared weapon. The records support the chain’s order and purpose, while the exact craft process and selectable weapon form remain matters for comparison with the Classic client.

events.name: A sign of hope, and an unfinished charge

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The final quest records Razelikh’s defeat and asks that his horn be returned to Trebor as a sign of hope. It also asks for the Ward of the Defiler so Trebor can destroy it. The request is clear; the destruction itself is not shown as a completed event in the evidence used here. Trebor’s story reaches a hard-won answer for the bound souls and the demon who held them. It does not record the fall of the Burning Legion, or every fate within its reach.

events.name: Kirith at Serpent’s Coil

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The quest turns toward Serpent’s Coil, where Kirith the Damned bars the way. The setting changes from open badlands to a low cave mouth on the coast. There the adventurer defeats the demon and the chain yields a new account through Kirith’s spirit. The art presents the beast in a broad, readable silhouette; it is not a reconstruction of the cave’s exact layout or proof of details absent from the quest record.

events.name: The amulet has three pieces

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Kirith’s spirit explains the next obstacle: Razelikh cannot be reached until the shattered amulet is made whole. Its three pieces are held by the demon’s lieutenants. The quest dialogue supplies the clue, not a new claim about Kirith’s final fate. The fragments now give the scattered work a shape. Trebor’s grievance can be answered only by confronting the power behind the bindings, and the seeker needs both knowledge and a weapon for that meeting.

events.name: Loramus and the demon hunter’s counsel

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The chain reaches Loramus Thalipedes on Azshara’s cold eastern shore. In the Classic quest account, the demon hunter helps direct the work that lies ahead: learn the demon’s true name and prepare a means to challenge him. The coast is broad and wind-cut, a different world from the Blasted Lands’ dry scar. This telling uses Loramus’s Classic-era counsel only; later retellings of his story do not replace what this quest chain records.

events.name: The name behind the title

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The search crosses Azshara’s pale coastal ruins, where the quest steps call for Hetaera’s blood and seek Lord Arkkoroc’s knowledge. The demon known as Razelikh the Defiler bears a truer name: Rakh’likh. That distinction is the chain’s discovery. Here, the old temple stone and blue water frame a hunt for usable knowledge, not a claim that every step took place in one room or followed an exact route along the coast.

events.name: Return with the forged weapons

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The quest line turns back to Trebor with the weapon prepared and the amulet’s scattered fragments to unite. This is an editorial journey through quest destinations, not a drawn route: its tasks name the regions but do not document each road taken. The exposed Blasted Lands return as the place where old bonds and new preparations converge. The demon’s title, the weapon and the amulet are now part of one effort to reach the Rise.

events.name: The stones that bind them

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The quest objective names eighteen bound servants: nine held by Razelikh and three each by Sevine, Allistarj and Grol. Their binding is represented by stones spread across the region, with no exact placement claimed here. The quest asks the seeker to break the hold upon them. In the exposed red earth, Trebor’s old loss becomes more than a memory: it becomes a task that can still release those who suffered under his command.

events.name: At the Rise of the Defiler

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: At the Rise of the Defiler, the united amulet lets the seeker bring the demon into the final contest. The known title falls away before the true name: Razelikh is Rakh’likh. Trebor’s old appeal has led here, from the souls once bound by the demon’s servants to a challenge against their master. The quests frame the meeting as a dangerous group confrontation but give no fixed battle formation. At the Rise, every preparation finds its purpose against the master whose servants once held Trebor’s soldiers.

events.name: The spirits may rest

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: When the binding stones are broken, the completion text says the tortured souls can rest. It gives Trebor the mercy he had sought for his soldiers, though the count remains unsettled by the separate nineteen-men line. The story pauses over that release without supplying names for the dead or turning each stone into a separate battle. A long burden has eased; the power behind the chains still stands.

events.name: Three lieutenants, three fragments

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The remaining amulet pieces come from Razelikh’s lieutenants: Allistarj, Sevine and Grol. Their encounters are separate, not one gathering in a field. In the tour they form a deliberate triptych, a memorial arrangement of three independent confrontations. When the fragments are brought together, the amulet is whole. Its completion opens the way that Kirith described, though the precise order of lieutenant encounters is not treated as a historical sequence beyond the quest dependency.

events.name: Trebor’s tale of sorrow

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Trebor recounts failure in battle, then a return to the Blasted Lands to rescue the men left behind. The account is one of defeat and obligation: he could not leave the captured soldiers to their torment. The reproduced Horde dialogue speaks of nineteen of his men, while the binding-stone objective counts eighteen bound servants. These are kept as two source details in tension. The surviving evidence does not resolve the difference.

events.name: Two roads to the Fallen Hero

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Fallen Hero quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The Blasted Lands are a country of exposed earth and old ruin, where Trebor’s defeat still has living consequences. Classic gives his story two introductions. The Alliance quest approaches him through a plea for common action against the Legion; the Horde chain follows lost orders and a courier’s report. These are separate faction paths, not one traveler’s shared itinerary. They meet at Trebor, whose concern has outlasted his own life: the soldiers he could not save.

events.name: The First War Begins

date.label: After the Dark Portal opens

events.summary: Horde forces entered Azeroth and began the war against the Kingdom of Stormwind.

events.name: The Forsaken Emerge in Lordaeron

date.label: As the Lich King's control weakens after the Legion's defeat

events.summary: Sylvanas and other undead broke from the Lich King's control and established a new, precarious power in the ruins of Lordaeron.

events.name: The Fourth War Campaign Ends

date.label: At the close of the Fourth War campaign

events.summary: A rebellion joined with Alliance pressure against Sylvanas's rule, bringing the war campaign to its end without erasing its losses.

events.name: The Fourth War Erupts

date.label: After the Legion campaign

events.summary: Alliance and Horde entered a global war of footholds, reprisals, and deepening fractures after the Legion's defeat.

events.name: The Great Sundering

date.label: c. 10,000 years before the Dark Portal

events.summary: The Well's destruction tore primordial Kalimdor apart, drowned great reaches of land, and left the Maelstrom at the center of a new ocean.

events.name: Grom Breaks Mannoroth's Bond

date.label: During the Kalimdor campaign

events.summary: After falling again beneath Mannoroth's corruption, Grom joined Thrall against the pit lord and died in the act that broke the immediate demonic bond over their people.

events.name: Gul'dan Abandons the Second War

date.label: During the Horde's northern campaign

events.summary: Gul'dan withdrew forces from the Horde's campaign for his own expedition, weakening Orgrim's offensive at a critical time.

events.name: Gul'dan Forms the Shadow Council

date.label: During the political consolidation of the clans

events.summary: After Ner'zhul resisted the Legion's course, Gul'dan organized a concealed warlock council and tightened hidden control around the forming Horde.

events.name: A'dal's answer

date.label: The Burning Crusade quest arc; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: A'dal cannot simply end the ancestors' suffering, but directs the seeker toward the naaru in Auchindoun.

events.name: A valley of restless voices

date.label: The Burning Crusade quest arc; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Reports of unrest lead the seeker through Nagrand's named ancestral sites, where the spirits point toward Oshu'gun.

events.name: The cycle beneath Auchindoun

date.label: The Burning Crusade quest arc; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: D'ore says the Light and Void cannot be separated from the naaru cycle, leaving a difficult choice for the ancestors.

events.name: Flashback · Demon Fall Canyon

date.label: The Burning Crusade quest arc; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Thrall's return brings Grom's last battle into view as a clearly labeled memory from the Third War.

events.name: Garadar beneath the Hellscream name

date.label: The Burning Crusade quest arc; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Garrosh carries shame over Grom's corruption and fears the same weakness lies within him.

events.name: A grandmother's urgent message

date.label: The Burning Crusade quest arc; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Geyah learns Thrall is her grandson and asks the seeker to carry her message across the sea.

events.name: Garrosh, son of Grom

date.label: The Burning Crusade quest arc; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The truth of Grom's sacrifice lifts Garrosh's shame; the story ends with restored pride and Geyah's recognition.

events.name: A chieftain who cannot hope

events.name: Illidan Seizes Power in Outland

date.label: After the Battle of Mount Hyjal

events.summary: Illidan and his allies closed portals, defeated Magtheridon's rule, and established a new center of power in Outland.

events.name: The Iron Horde Opens an Alternate Front

date.label: After the Siege of Orgrimmar

events.summary: An invasion from an alternate Draenor opened a separate-world campaign against the Iron Horde.

events.name: The Kaldorei Ascend

date.label: Across generations beside the Well

events.summary: Changed by long proximity to the Well, the emerging kaldorei mastered arcane power, built cities, and expanded across Kalimdor.

events.name: A key in three pieces

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Khadgar explains that, while stranded in Outland, he split his key into three and hid the pieces inside enchanted containers. The places seemed safe when he chose them; Outland has changed since then. His explanation gives the search its shape, but not a single road: each fragment lies in a separate dungeon, and each location reflects a world now fought over by new powers.

events.name: Beneath the sealed tower

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Alturus gives the seeker a Violet Scrying Crystal and asks for readings from underground water in the Master’s Cellar. In the quest’s report, the expected arcane currents are absent: the tower registers as a vast energy vacuum, with only a faint demonic echo. That phrase is Alturus’s reading of the crystal, not a confirmed identity for the presence. The cellar returns a warning, but not yet an answer.

events.name: A question among the ashes

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: After studying the journal, Alturus proposes that Medivh may have woven some of his essence into the magic that defeated Arcanagos. If so, he reasons, a trace might remain in the dragon’s bones. The quest sends the seeker to find a Charred Bone Fragment in the mountains south of Karazhan. This is Alturus’s hypothesis and a search for evidence, not a confirmation that the essence can be recovered.

events.name: A report reaches Dalaran

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Alturus sends his report to Archmage Cedric in Dalaran’s old crater. Cedric has learned that the tower sealed itself off and that the Violet Eye lost contact with agents within it. The new reading gives the old silence another urgency. Cedric points toward one person who might reopen the way: Khadgar, Medivh’s former apprentice, now living in Shattrath. The ruined crater is Dalaran’s original site, not the city’s later home in Northrend.

events.name: The first fragment in Auchindoun

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The first fragment rests in the Shadow Labyrinth, among passages occupied by the Shadow Council. Khadgar’s account places the container there because the labyrinth once seemed a safe hiding place. The return of the fragment changes the key from a distant memory into a recoverable object. It does not yet open the tower; two pieces remain beyond reach.

events.name: Kalynna’s offer

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Alturus sends the bone to Kalynna Lathred in Area 52. She once belonged to the Kirin Tor, but now follows studies her old order forbade. The fragment’s essence, Alturus says, is lifeless—like Arcanagos. Kalynna believes she can help, but her own research has a cost. Her answer turns the Violet Eye’s question into a bargain between scholars with different boundaries.

events.name: Two books, two halls

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Kalynna asks for two books before she will complete the favor. The Tome of Dusk belongs to the orc warlock Nethekurse in the Shattered Halls; the Book of Forgotten Names is held by Darkweaver Syth in Sethekk Halls. The quest requires heroic versions of both dungeons. These are the terms of a research exchange, not separate historical turning points, and the two halls retain their distinct landscapes in this paired itinerary.

events.name: Khadgar in Shattrath

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: In Shattrath, Khadgar receives Alturus’s account and sees a familiar problem in it. Karazhan cannot simply be forced open; the Master’s Key once held that power, and he knows the key’s history. He will help restore it, though the next stages will cross Outland’s changed strongholds. The meeting begins the fragment quest line. It is a new undertaking prompted by Alturus’s report, not proof that the Violet Eye has already learned what happened inside the tower.

events.name: A memory of Arcanagos

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: On the Master’s Terrace, the journal opens onto an older meeting. The blue dragon Arcanagos warns Medivh that a dark power seeks to use him, and urges him to leave the tower. Medivh refuses. Magic burns through the dragon from within; Arcanagos flies away aflame. The scene is a memory carried by the journal, not a new event occurring during the Violet Eye’s present investigation.

events.name: Nightbane on the terrace

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: With Kalynna’s materials placed in a Blackened Urn, the seeker returns to the Master’s Terrace and sets it alight. The quest says the released energy raises Arcanagos’s charred remains as Nightbane. The adventurer defeats the dragon and carries its essence back to Alturus, whose hope is to study what the fragment may reveal about Medivh. The chain ends with a sample and a research question—not a complete explanation of the Guardian’s magic, nor a later chapter in Arcanagos’s history.

events.name: Reports from Deadwind Pass

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Archmage Alturus watches the road below Karazhan while the Violet Eye studies a tower that has kept its doors closed. His first assignments open along two parallel paths: Arcane Disturbances and Restless Activity. One sends the seeker beneath the tower; the other concerns the restless dead around it. The quests establish a troubled place and an order to investigate. They do not establish that either task caused the tower’s condition, or that the source of every disturbance is already known.

events.name: The key returns to Shattrath

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The restored key returns to Khadgar in Shattrath, and the attunement chain reaches its stated end. A way into Karazhan now exists. The tower’s condition and the fate of its trapped investigators remain matters for the Violet Eye to examine. That distinction closes one quest and leaves another question standing at the gate.

events.name: A fragment under the Steamvault

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The second container is found in the Steamvault beneath Coilfang Reservoir. Khadgar recalls hiding it under Serpent Lake before the place was known by that name; he suspects the naga’s great drain carried it into the reservoir. That explanation is his best account of a changed landscape, not a witnessed transfer. The fragment is recovered, while the precise course of its movement remains uncertain.

events.name: A separate search for the journal

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The Violet Eye’s next inquiry is related by the tower, not by a shared quest dependency: after establishing a foothold inside Karazhan and earning the required standing, Alturus asks the adventurer to find Medivh’s Journal. Agents sent before have not returned; Wravien was the last named seeker. This is a distinct research chain joined here for its evidence about the tower’s history. It does not follow automatically from handing Khadgar the key.

events.name: The investigators among the books

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Inside the Guardian’s Library, Wravien struggles to remember his commission and sends the seeker to Gradav. Gradav also cannot leave his own work, then points toward Kamsis. The three exchanges make the library’s abundance part of the obstacle: each agent offers a fragment of direction, while none can simply lead the search to its end. Their quest dialogue records confusion and fixation; it does not fully explain what the tower has done to them.

events.name: The Master’s Touch

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Khadgar restores the key but says it will remain useless without Medivh’s consent. In the Black Morass, the seeker travels to a remembered past at the Opening of the Dark Portal. There, Medivh recognizes the key as Khadgar’s and acknowledges that he has not yet given it to his apprentice. The meeting belongs to a time-travel quest scene, not to a present-day journey through the swamp. The key receives the permission Khadgar could not grant for himself.

events.name: The Shade of Aran and the journal

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Kamsis directs the search toward the Shade of Aran, Medivh’s father. When the shade is overcome, Medivh’s Journal is recovered from the encounter and returned to the Violet Eye’s inquiry. The discovery changes the work from searching for a lost book to reading what the book can reveal. Its pages are not a neutral report from an observer: the next quest treats them as a way to witness one of Medivh’s own memories.

events.name: The prison above Netherstorm

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original quest chronology; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The third fragment lies within the Arcatraz, a prison in the Tempest Keep complex. Khadgar had hidden it while the naaru held the fortress; by the time the seeker arrives, Kael’thas’s forces have turned the vessel into a place of confinement. The key’s last piece is retrieved from a refuge that has become dangerous. The three fragments can now be taken back to their maker.

events.name: The Dimensius Crisis on K’aresh

date.label: During Ghosts of K’aresh (2025)

events.summary: The struggle over the Dark Heart reaches shattered K’aresh, where the Shadow Guard seeks to restore Dimensius.
events.description: This offworld campaign is presented as a separate worldspace. The source links the Dimensius crisis to the next Worldsoul Saga chapter; the atlas does not assign it an Azeroth map position.

events.name: Kil'jaeden Finds the Draenei on Draenor

date.label: Approximately thirteen years before the Dark Portal; working chronology

events.summary: Kil'jaeden discovered Velen's exiles on Draenor and chose the orc clans as the instrument of his revenge.

date.label: After the Highborne portal opened

events.summary: Demonic forces poured through the portal at Zin-Azshari and began destroying the empire whose court had admitted them.

events.name: Lei Shen Unites the Mogu

events.summary: Lei Shen overcame rival mogu kings and gathered their competing realms into a single imperial power.

events.name: The Lich King Falls at Icecrown

date.label: During the Northrend campaign

events.summary: The campaign through Northrend reached Icecrown, where Arthas's reign as the Lich King ended.

events.name: The Long Vigil Begins

date.label: After Nordrassil was established

events.summary: Post-Sundering kaldorei society took up a long watch over Kalimdor and against the return of the Burning Legion.

events.name: Lordaeron Falls to the Scourge

date.label: After Arthas returns from Northrend

events.summary: Arthas returned as a death knight, killed his father, and helped bring the kingdom of Lordaeron under the Scourge.

events.name: Anduin Lothar Falls Near Blackrock Spire

date.label: During the Alliance counteroffensive in the Second War

events.summary: Lothar died during the confrontation near Blackrock Spire, creating a moment of shock that Turalyon turned into resolve.

events.name: The Void Assault on Quel’Thalas

date.label: At the opening of Midnight (March 2026)

events.summary: Xal’atath and the Devouring Host assault the Sunwell; Quel’Thalas survives the first incursion after defenders force a temporary retreat.
events.description: The first defense buys time while Lightbloom and other pressures continue to threaten the homeland.

events.name: A docket at Addle’s Stead

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Backus directs the search to Addle’s Stead and verifies the recovered docket.
events.description: Watcher Backus recalls unusual Defias activity around Addle’s Stead. The farm lies apart from Stormwind’s ordered streets, its fields dark beneath Duskwood’s clouded canopy. A search of the hideout yields a docket from a chest. Backus can tell that the papers are authentic, but the matter has grown beyond local watchwork. He returns the evidence to Elling, who can read its wider implications.

events.name: What waits on Alcaz

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The aerial survey reveals a rune circle and several distinct groups on Alcaz.
events.description: The gryphon passes above Alcaz’s wet, broken ground. The survey sees a rune circle, black dragonflight, naga, hydras and human figures among the island’s marsh pools. These details establish a crowded and dangerous place, not an alliance between every group present. The scene’s aerial composition is an interpretive reconstruction based on the quest report; it does not claim that the investigator maps every camp or finds the prisoner.

events.name: A diplomat does not arrive

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: DeLavey says the envoy bound for a meeting with Jaina never arrived.
events.description: Bishop DeLavey explains the absence that the city has not yet made common knowledge: a diplomat sent to Theramore to meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore never reached his destination. The king’s agents are already searching, but the bishop will set his own contacts in motion. A sealed letter leads first to Jorgen, a fisherman in the Valley of Heroes. The story has a destination, though not yet a culprit.

events.name: A warning at Stormwind Keep

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Bolvar plans renewed action; Katrana opposes the report without being named its patron.
events.description: Jaina sends the findings to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon. He accepts the seriousness of her report and plans renewed action against the Defias until the king is returned. Lady Katrana Prestor urges him to turn elsewhere, dismissing the charge as speculation. Her objection is part of the record; it does not identify her as the patron or prove a connection to the disappearance. Bolvar asks that Jaina hear his thanks.

events.name: The second plan

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Dashel says Plan A failed and identifies Slim’s Menethil lead.
events.description: Dashel Stonefist is not the author of the whole scheme. He admits that the first plan failed and points to a second one involving Tapoke “Slim” Jahn in Menethil Harbor. The clue sends the inquiry north, beyond the green woods and toward the Wetlands’ cold coast. A failed operation has left a loose end; the search follows it to the inn where Slim believes he can remain unnoticed.

events.name: The watcher in Duskwood

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Elling routes the investigation to Watcher Backus and Defias activity.
events.description: Elling Trias accepts the courier’s message and sends the search toward Watcher Backus in Duskwood. The instruction concerns recent Defias activity, but it does not yet prove why the brotherhood has entered the inquiry. Each handoff narrows the field while leaving motive uncertain. From Stormwind’s pale walls, the road now leads into a wooded country where old farmsteads and fog keep their own counsel.

events.name: The name behind the papers

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Elling identifies Dashel Stonefist as the next lead.
events.description: Elling studies the docket and finds a name he recognizes: Dashel Stonefist, a resident of Stormwind’s Old Town. Backus had seen the papers; Elling can follow them. That distinction turns a cache of documents into a human lead. The investigation returns to the city not because the danger has passed, but because its next door is hidden among familiar streets and guarded reputations.

events.name: Orders for precious cargo

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Garn’s orders reveal valuable cargo and an unnamed wealthy patron.
events.description: Captain Wymor’s scouts describe red-bandana Defias near the wreck, an odd sight far from their Stormwind trade. On a nearby island, Garn Mathers holds a written order telling him to protect the cargo at any cost and promising a rich reward for success and silence. The note implies a patron with means, but it does not name one. Wymor sends the order to Renn McGill, the salvage diver already searching the shore.

events.name: Hendel taken into custody

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Hendel is subdued and placed in Jaina and Tervosh’s custody.
events.description: Hendel resists when confronted, and nearby guards join the struggle. The adventurer subdues him; Tervosh and Jaina arrive, and custody passes to them. The chain ends with a prisoner and a name already connected to Varian’s ship, not with the king’s rescue. No later comic, later game account, or unseen voyage is used to close the gap. The investigation has found a participant, while its central disappearance remains unresolved.

events.name: Jaina must know

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Renn brings evidence of an unknown prisoner to Jaina.
events.description: Renn urges the investigator to report the manacles to Jaina without delay. The prisoner’s identity and fate are not established by the object itself; it only proves that a person was restrained. Theramore’s pale walls rise above the marsh and the sea, a place where the evidence can be weighed against the old report of Varian’s vanished voyage. Jaina now has a new clue, but still not the whole design.

events.name: An island not yet entered

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Jaina chooses an aerial survey instead of a costly ground assault.
events.description: Jaina says Renn’s suspicion about Alcaz Island merits a survey, but a force large enough to fight through the island would overstrain Theramore’s defenses. She arranges an aerial inspection with Cassa Crimsonwing, an apprentice gryphon handler. The choice is cautious: gather knowledge before committing troops. From above the marsh, the island can be observed without pretending that its hidden defenders or their purpose are already understood.

events.name: A fisherman’s letter

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Jorgen passes a sealed letter to Elling Trias.
events.description: Jorgen recognizes the bishop’s seal and accepts the duty reluctantly. He writes another letter for Elling Trias and insists that the confidence placed in him pass onward intact. No weapon is drawn, yet the chain of trust is already a route: from a church office, through a fisherman, toward a man who trades in information. The search moves by people who know how to keep a name quiet.

events.name: A later wreck on the Dreadmurk Shore

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Aden sends the investigator to examine Defias survivors and wreckage.
events.description: The original chain and the patch 2.3 continuation are presented as separate historical evidence, joined here by editorial order rather than an asserted quest dependency. Lieutenant Aden reports Defias survivors near a shipwreck on the Dreadmurk Shore and sends the investigator to Captain Wymor at Sentry Point. The report opens a new inquiry: if the wreck is theirs, what did the Defias carry, and why were they searching its scattered remains?

events.name: Renn’s secondhand gear

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Renn prepares the investigator to search the wreck with repaired gear.
events.description: Renn McGill confirms that the Defias have divers among the wreckage and accepts the orders as a reason to search first. The scattered ship remains stretch from the eastern coast of the island toward Alcaz, while the naga-held waters are dangerous. Before the diver can enter the search, damaged diving gear and tools must be recovered and repaired. The work turns the hidden cargo into a physical trail under the waterline.

events.name: The inquiry remains open

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Jaina receives the report; the patron and Varian’s fate remain unresolved.
events.description: The messenger returns to Jaina with Bolvar’s response. The patch 2.3 chain closes on thanks and suspicion, not a rescue. The manacles prove a prisoner was carried; the island holds a rune circle and several groups; Jaina believes a powerful Alliance patron stands behind the Defias. The patron remains unnamed, Varian remains missing, and the original and later quest chains remain distinct evidence. The history stops where the surviving account stops.

events.name: The boxes beneath the water

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The recovered manacles show that the cargo included a human prisoner.
events.description: Among the ship’s broken timbers, salvaged strongboxes bring coins, jewelry and letters to the surface. Most are only remnants of a scattered cargo. Renn finds something different among them: enchanted iron manacles. Their presence changes the question. The precious cargo was not simply a cache of valuables; someone had been bound aboard the ship. The evidence points to a human prisoner, but gives no new identity beyond the earlier Classic disclosure.

events.name: The marine commander

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The inquiry crosses to Theramore and Commander Samaul.
events.description: The harbor account points toward Commander Samaul in Theramore. The lead concerns Kul Tiras marines who travel from Theramore to Menethil on leave; Elling’s name is the sign that earns Samaul’s confidence. The inquiry crosses the sea again, from damp northern docks to a fortified port built on Dustwallow’s marshland. It follows a military posting, not a proven escape route for Varian.

events.name: The first tower

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Samaul places Hendel at Sentry Point.
events.description: Commander Samaul is cautious with a stranger, then names Private Hendel’s last post: Sentry Point, the first tower beyond Theramore. The tower stands as a watch over marsh and shore, a practical outpost between the city and the uncertain coast. The search has narrowed to one soldier, but Samaul’s report does not establish what Hendel knows or whether he still serves the plan Slim described.

events.name: The trail stops here

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Jaina rewards the investigator; Varian’s disappearance remains unresolved.
events.description: Jaina thanks the adventurer with her signet ring. That gift marks the service rendered, not the return of the missing king. The original chain closes at Theramore with Hendel held for questioning and Varian still absent from the story’s known scenes. The evidence has moved across Stormwind, Duskwood, the Wetlands and the marsh coast; the destination of the royal ship and the full design behind its disappearance remain beyond this account.

events.name: A flight through Menethil

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Slim tries to flee the inn and is subdued at Menethil Harbor.
events.description: In Menethil Harbor, Slim hears that Elling’s inquiry has reached the inn. He tries to slip away, and the encounter becomes a brief struggle outside the crowded waterside rooms. The Wetlands are not merely a crossing between continents here; they are the place where a quiet investigation finally meets a suspect face to face. Slim is subdued, and the questions can begin.

events.name: The mage’s assistance

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Tervosh confirms Jaina’s support and points west to Hendel.
events.description: At Sentry Point, Archmage Tervosh says Jaina knows of the inquiry and has directed him to assist. Hendel is west of the tower, keeping watch over Theramore’s scouts as they return from searching for Brackenwall. This is an account of the quest’s lead, not a claim that every named figure shares the illustrated frame. The marsh has yielded the soldier’s position; the confrontation itself remains ahead.

events.name: A quiet summons

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Thomas recruits an adventurer to meet Bishop DeLavey privately.
events.description: At the Cathedral of Light, Thomas asks for an adventurer who can keep a matter private. He names no cause in the open square; only Bishop DeLavey waits inside Stormwind Keep. The request is small in sound and large in implication: someone within the kingdom has chosen discretion before disclosure. The investigation begins with a sealed threshold, not a public alarm.

events.name: A patron in high places

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Jaina infers a powerful Alliance patron, whose identity remains unknown.
events.description: Jaina concludes that Defias hedge magic cannot explain the rune circle and that the island’s groups leave many questions unanswered. Her firmest inference is narrower: the Defias have a powerful ally high in the Alliance. She also tells the investigator that their plan is tied to Varian’s disappearance. The connection is now stated by Jaina, but neither the patron’s identity nor the groups’ relationship is resolved.

events.name: The missing king

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Slim identifies Varian Wrynn and implicates Hendel in the ship plan.
events.description: Slim gives up the name at the center of the search: the “diplomat” is Varian Wrynn, Stormwind’s missing king. Slim says Hendel was meant to board the king’s ship. This portrait is a record of the absent subject, not a claim that Varian stood at the Menethil inn. The trail now has a face and an intended accomplice, but no recovered king and no account of what became of the voyage.

events.name: The Mogu Empire Expands

date.label: After Lei Shen's unification

events.summary: The new empire subdued neighboring peoples and imposed its rule across much of the southern lands later known as Pandaria.

events.name: Neltharion Turns the Dragon Soul on His Allies

date.label: During the War of the Ancients

events.summary: After using the Dragon Soul against the Legion, Neltharion revealed his betrayal and shattered the unity of the dragonflights.

events.name: Ner'zhul Is Deceived Against the Draenei

date.label: Before Gul'dan assumes the Legion's work

events.summary: Kil'jaeden exploited Ner'zhul's authority and grief to turn orc suspicion and violence toward the draenei.

events.name: An ally of the Netherwing

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The chain returns to Mordenai, who recognizes the seeker as an ally of the Netherwing.

events.name: A choice in the Lower City

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Barthamus receives the survivor in Shattrath and presents one of six possible Netherwing drake companions.

events.name: An oath for a home

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: At neutral standing, Mordenai asks the ally to help retake Netherwing lands and protect the flight.

events.name: The crystal’s force

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The enchanted crystal is used on enslaved Netherwing drakes; the freed drakes turn on their captors.

events.name: A breach to buy time

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The seeker strikes the Dragonmaw fortress to create a diversion while Neltharaku considers his next step.

events.name: The summons of the Highlord

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: After a reputation-gated interval, Varkule summons the exalted seeker; Mor’ghor names them the first Highlord of the Dragonmaw.

events.name: The borrowed face is seen through

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Illidan recognizes the deception at the promotion gathering, immobilizes the player, and orders Mor’ghor to have them killed.

events.name: Karynaku above the bailey

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The chain turns from freeing captive drakes to reaching Karynaku, who remains bound at the fortress.

events.name: A kindness in the fields

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Mordenai asks the seeker to aid the disturbed Netherwing drakes. The opening task pairs the gathering of Rocknail prey with feeding the drakes; the scene treats those objectives as one appeal rather than a string of farming actions.

events.name: A revolt beneath the ledge

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: An optional friendly-standing branch leads from escape plans to an interrogation. An unnamed Murkblood overseer describes an attempted mine revolt and makes allegations about Dragonmaw extraction and buyers.

events.name: A flight’s testimony

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Neltharaku tells the seeker of the Dragonmaw’s control over the Netherwing and asks for help.

events.name: Crystals from the ledge

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Neltharaku’s plan turns on crystals gathered from Netherwing Ledge.

events.name: Search above the broken fields

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: After the opening aid, Mordenai directs the seeker to search the skies for Neltharaku.

events.name: A mask of Dragonmaw

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Netherwing magic disguises the seeker as a Dragonmaw recruit; Illidari papers are delivered to Mor’ghor, opening the taskmaster route.

events.name: A friend behind the disguise

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Yarzill the Merc reveals himself as a Netherwing ally within the Dragonmaw operation.

events.name: Wings beneath the merchant’s cloak

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Yarzill intervenes, reveals a Netherwing drake form, and carries the seeker to Shattrath.

events.name: The chieftain’s key

date.label: The Burning Crusade Netherwing quest campaign; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Zuluhed is defeated, the key is recovered, and Karynaku’s chains are opened.

events.name: The New Horde Crosses to Kalimdor

date.label: As the northern crisis widens

events.summary: Warned of the coming danger, Thrall led the New Horde west across the sea and began building a future in Kalimdor.

events.name: Resistance Forms Against the Invasion

date.label: As the Legion spread beyond Zin-Azshari

events.summary: Kaldorei who rejected Azshara's course organized a resistance in which Malfurion, Tyrande, and Illidan each played consequential roles.

events.name: Nordrassil Is Planted

date.label: After the second Well was discovered

events.summary: A World Tree was planted over the new Well at Hyjal, binding the postwar refuge to a new charge of protection.

events.name: The Assault of N'Zoth Is Defeated

date.label: At the end of the N'Zoth campaign

events.summary: Champions carried the struggle into Ny'alotha and ended N'Zoth's immediate assault on Azeroth.

events.name: N'Zoth Is Unleashed

date.label: After the Fourth War campaign

events.summary: N'Zoth's release brought assaults and corrupting visions against an already wounded Azeroth.

events.name: Arrival of the Old Gods

date.label: After untold ages of elemental conflict

events.summary: A group of Old Gods struck Azeroth from the Great Dark, embedded themselves in different parts of the world, and extended their influence toward its core.

events.name: The Old Gods Are Contained

date.label: After the fall of the Black Empire

events.summary: Unable to remove the remaining Old Gods without repeating the wound caused by Y'Shaarj's destruction, the keepers bound them in prisons beneath Azeroth.

events.name: Scattering of the Old Gods

date.label: Before the Old Gods struck Azeroth

events.summary: The Void Lords made the Old Gods and cast them through the Great Dark, hoping that some would find and corrupt a world-soul.
events.description: The event name is an editorial label. The cosmography asserts sequence and purpose but no origin coordinate, route, or measurable number of Old Gods.

events.name: Blood and the Drakefire Amulet

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: In Upper Blackrock Spire, the adventurers face General Drakkisath and bring his blood to Haleh. From that trial comes the Drakefire Amulet, a ward that allows its bearer to withstand Onyxia’s lair. The Alliance has gone from suspicion to exposure and now to preparation. The key is won; the descent into the dragon’s den waits ahead.

events.name: A final skull over the Wetlands

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Axtroz waits amid the windswept Wetlands, where rain and low cloud soften the coast. This final dragon trial completes the tribute demanded by Emberstrife. Across Kalimdor’s distant shores and the Eastern Kingdoms, each challenge has brought the adventurers nearer to the mountain. Now their road turns back to Blackrock, where Drakkisath waits.

events.name: Finding Rexxar

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Across Desolace, the adventurers seek Rexxar, a wandering champion of the Horde. His place between the wilds and settled life makes him the guide to a difficult next task. Here the great campaign narrows to a search for one champion moving through an immense, sparse land. Rexxar sets the terms for learning how an adventurer might pass the protections around Onyxia’s lair.

events.name: A shadow over the Burning Steppes

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: In the Burning Steppes, black dragonkin gather beneath a sky troubled by ash. Their attacks turn a frontier alarm into a question about the reach of the black dragonflight. The Alliance investigation begins with scattered signs and grows toward the mountain that shelters them. The evidence points to a danger with a foothold beyond the wilds; it does not yet reveal the hand guiding Stormwind’s court.

events.name: A path to Haleh

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: From the capital, the road winds into blue-white winter and brings the adventurers to Haleh. The Dragon’s Eye is the token that opens her counsel, turning Stormwind’s revelation into preparation. She names the test that lies ahead: the blood of a mighty black dragon, taken high within Blackrock Spire. Frost will soon give way to furnace heat.

events.name: The elder’s counsel

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: At Orgrimmar, Eitrigg’s counsel turns the reports into a charge for the Horde. The old veteran understands the danger gathering around Blackrock and sends the adventurers back toward the stronghold with a clearer purpose. The city’s red stone and timber frame a different kind of authority from Stormwind’s court: experience offered in service to the Horde. Its path leads next to a contest for Blackrock Spire.

events.name: The dragon who tests the mask

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: In the heat and dark water of Dustwallow Marsh, Emberstrife tests the forged appearance and sends the adventurers to claim dragon skulls from distant guardians. Three trials await beneath different skies, where the black dragonflight and its rivals still shape the wilds. Emberstrife will accept each skull as part of his demand; Myranda’s borrowed shape must hold until the passage is won.

events.name: A challenge in Blackrock Spire

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: The Horde’s orders bring the adventurers against Warchief Rend Blackhand in Blackrock Spire. His defeat and the proof carried away from it fulfill the charge entrusted to them. The mountain holds more than one danger, and the struggle with Rend belongs to the Horde’s own contest of power. It is a separate road from Windsor’s rescue, even as both paths approach the black dragon’s shadow.

events.name: The Great Masquerade

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Before the assembled court, Katrana Prestor’s disguise falls away. The woman who had stood near Stormwind’s seat of power is revealed as Onyxia, the black dragon whose agents troubled the frontier. Dragonkin answer her presence, and Bolvar stands against the assault as the adventurers fight to defend the Keep. The conspiracy is exposed, yet Onyxia escapes the city. Stormwind has found its hidden enemy, not ended the danger.

events.name: The blood of Drakkisath

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: The Horde returns to Upper Blackrock Spire to confront General Drakkisath. The blood taken from this powerful black dragon completes the trial Rexxar laid before them. The Alliance has passed through its own hands to reach Haleh; the Horde has followed its leaders and its own road. Their stories share a threshold, but each company bears a separate history.

events.name: The way out of the mountain

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: The escape from Blackrock Depths is hard won. Windsor leads the way through hostile halls while his rescuers hold open each turn in the passage. Stormwind cannot hear its witness while he remains beneath the mountain. When the group emerges, the marshal can return to the city and place what he knows before the people who must judge it.

events.name: Into the dragon’s lair

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: The Drakefire Amulet opens the way to Onyxia’s Lair, where a band of champions at last faces the black dragon herself. The road began differently for those who came from Stormwind and those who answered the Horde’s call; each company enters beneath its own banners. Fire shivers across the stone as Onyxia takes wing. The struggle reaches its summit in this original Classic account, though its nameless adventurers are remembered as a company, not a single chosen champion.

events.name: Rexxar’s Drakefire Amulet

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Back with Rexxar, the adventurers receive the Drakefire Amulet. The token bears the protection gathered from every trial and opens the way before them. The Horde has come to this gate by a road all its own: through intelligence, Eitrigg’s counsel, Thrall’s word, Rexxar’s charge and a dragon’s blood. At the mountain’s foot, that labor gives way to a final descent.

events.name: A shred of evidence

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: A crumpled note points toward the fragments Windsor needs. The search passes through the forge and deeper chambers of Blackrock Mountain, where small pieces of a document matter more than the strength of the gates. Recovered evidence gives Windsor grounds to leave his cell and face the city again. This is the work of a rescue and an investigation together: one carries the other back into the light.

events.name: The marshal returns

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Windsor comes back to Stormwind with the evidence gathered in Blackrock. The capital that once seemed distant from the frontier danger now becomes the stage for its reckoning. Bolvar receives the marshal’s return, and the city’s uneasy court gathers around the claim. The journey has changed the question: instead of asking whether the marshal can escape, the Alliance must decide whether it can hear him.

events.name: Myranda’s borrowed shape

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Rexxar’s instruction leads to Myranda the Hag in the blighted Western Plaguelands. Her magic prepares a means of taking a dragon’s shape, a disguise needed for the work to come. It does not make the adventurers dragons or erase their purpose; it is a temporary tool for passing the watchers of the mountain. In the scarred land, the Horde’s road turns from finding an ally to testing a dangerous deception.

events.name: Three trials, three horizons

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Three guardians stand in lands far apart: Chronalis beneath the Tanaris sun, Scryer amid Winterspring snow, and Somnus beneath the Swamp of Sorrows’ green canopy. Each place holds its own weather and color, and each dragon bears one part of the trial Emberstrife set. With the three skulls gathered, the Horde can complete his charge and carry Myranda’s borrowed shape toward the black dragon’s mountain.

events.name: The court’s new voice

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Reports from Redridge and the Burning Steppes carry the search into Stormwind. In the Keep, Bolvar Fordragon bears the kingdom’s regency while Countess Katrana Prestor speaks with unusual influence. To the investigators, the mystery is no longer only a nest of dragonkin: a trusted figure sits within the very hall they are trying to protect. The resemblance between rumor and conspiracy remains a question still to be proved.

events.name: Orders from the Badlands

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Far from Stormwind’s court, the Horde receives a separate summons in the Badlands. Orders point toward the stronghold of Blackrock Spire and the power held there. This path does not begin as an answer to Windsor’s investigation; it grows from Horde intelligence, leaders and obligations of its own. The same mountain appears on another horizon, where a different people must decide what its threat means.

events.name: Thrall’s account

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: At Orgrimmar, Thrall speaks of the danger and sends the search outward toward Rexxar. The Warchief’s words widen the matter into a concern for the Horde itself. The tale now leaves the city’s red stone and timber for the open country. Ahead lies a champion whose life at the edge of society has made him known across Kalimdor.

events.name: The marshal in Blackrock Depths

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

events.summary: Deep in Blackrock Depths, Marshal Windsor has been held away from the court whose danger he understands. His account is not enough by itself to undo the power that silenced him. The adventurers find a soldier who has carried the truth through imprisonment, and a trail of evidence scattered through the fortress. The mountain’s iron rooms have become the place where a political mystery waits for its missing proof.

events.name: Orc Clans Drink Mannoroth's Blood

date.label: Before the final assault on Shattrath

events.summary: Many orc leaders accepted Mannoroth's blood and its power, binding the Horde more deeply to the Legion; Durotan kept the Frostwolves from drinking.

events.name: Orgrim Doomhammer Becomes Warchief

date.label: During the First War

events.summary: Orgrim killed Blackhand, broke much of the Shadow Council's concealed power, and assumed leadership of the Horde.

events.name: The Dark Portal Leads Back to Outland

date.label: After the Ahn'Qiraj campaign

events.summary: A renewed passage through the Dark Portal carried Azeroth's forces into shattered Outland and the conflicts rooted there.

events.name: The Pandaren Revolution

date.label: After generations of mogu rule

events.summary: Resistance associated with Kang spread among the mogu's subject peoples until the imperial order broke and the southern lands entered a new age.

events.name: Pandaria Returns to the Wider World

date.label: After the Cataclysm

events.summary: The long-hidden land of Pandaria became a theater of exploration and intensifying Alliance–Horde conflict.

events.name: The Pantheon Departs

date.label: After the ordering of Azeroth

events.summary: With Azeroth stabilized and its guardians appointed, the Pantheon departed while the keepers and titan-forged remained to watch over the world.

events.name: The Pantheon Discovers Azeroth

date.label: During the Black Empire's dominion

events.summary: Aggramar discovered Azeroth's nascent titan and the Old Gods rooted around it, bringing the imperiled world to the Pantheon's attention.

events.name: Gathering of the Pantheon

date.label: During Aman’Thul's search for other titans

events.summary: The awakened titans found one another, formed the Pantheon, and traveled onward to order worlds and seek more of their kind.
events.description: The event name is an editorial label for the Pantheon's formation in Chronicle Volume 1.

events.name: Emergence of the Physical Universe

date.label: At the beginning of Chronicle's cosmic account

events.summary: The conflict between primordial Light and Void gave rise to the physical universe, while released energies formed the Twisting Nether.
events.description: The event name is an editorial label for the creation sequence described in Chronicle Volume 1; it is not presented as a formally named Warcraft event.

events.name: The Plague Spreads Through Lordaeron

date.label: At the opening of the Third War

events.summary: A mysterious plague spread through Lordaeron as the Cult of the Damned and Scourge prepared the kingdom's destruction.

events.name: The Portal at the Well Collapses

date.label: At the end of the War of the Ancients

events.summary: The defenders disrupted the Legion's gateway before Sargeras could enter, and the unstable Well collapsed around the broken portal.

events.name: A hilt without a finder

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: In the Frozen Halls, a battered hilt may fall among the spoils of heroic danger. Its appearance is randomized game loot; no single finder belongs to history. The quest then brings the relic to Quel’Delar’s Rest, where the Silver Covenant or Sunreavers take up the question it carries. Before the sword is whole, its broken remnant has already drawn two rival courts toward the same inheritance.

events.name: The sword draws toward the Halls

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: From the frozen forge, Quel’Delar presses its bearer toward the Halls of Reflection. The quest frames this as compulsion: the blade has a will, and its direction leads into the Lich King’s chamber. This is a magical story beat, not a route inferred across a map. In the blue-black hall, the sword’s restoration turns inward. The first danger is no longer whether it can be wielded, but who commands whom.

events.name: A gift carried through generations

date.label: Before the Third War; exact date and ceremony location are not established here

events.summary: In the older account, Alexstrasza gives the blade to Anasterian, and the high king later entrusts it to Thalorien Dawnseeker. This is a remembered handoff, not a ceremony whose room or date the tale records. The Sunwell’s light fills this interpretive scene because the sword’s future defense is bound to Quel’Thalas. Its gold and red radiance now illuminates a gift moving toward its trial.

events.name: The name in the record

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; remembered history predates the quest

events.summary: Returned to the dragon’s record, the story of the hilt resolves into a name: Quel’Delar, sister to Quel’Serrar. Its remembered history binds red dragonflight craft to the high elven crown and to a defender who stood before the Sunwell. The book does not make the sword’s inheritance simple. It tells how a gift can outlive a kingdom’s wound, while leaving its next bearer to be contested.

events.name: A borrowed guise for old records

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: A disguise opens a way to records guarded by suspicion and old allegiances. The faction quest asks its chosen seeker to recover the ancient dragonforged blades’ history, not to invent a new forging tale. In this retelling, the folio is an interpretive emblem for that record. A successful theft is a game objective; the chronicle keeps the danger and purpose, not every repeated step of play.

events.name: The dragons weigh the risk

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: At Wyrmrest Temple, Krasus lends the seekers a record of the ancient blade. Kalecgos asks whether mortals should command such power: the dragons have known the grief of a mighty weapon turned against them. Alexstrasza permits the search to continue, though permission is not an answer to every fear. Beneath the red-bronze shrine, the hilt’s past begins to emerge as both a promise and a warning.

events.name: Two returns, no single heir

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest resolution; individual character choices vary

events.summary: The restored weapon returns to Dalaran by faction-specific roads. An Alliance seeker reports through Caladis and the Silver Covenant; a Horde seeker through Myralion and the Sunreavers. In the blood-elf sword branch, Aethas publicly presents the new bearer. Other characters unable to wield the sword receive a different weapon type. These are alternative game outcomes, not one champion’s combined history, and no named adventurer is made the canonical heir.

events.name: Tempered in the Forge of Souls

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The newly joined blade travels to the Crucible of Souls, deep within the Forge of Souls. There it is tempered amid the machinery of the Lich King’s frozen halls. The glowing furnace is an interpretive setting for a named quest step, not a measured reconstruction of the dungeon room. The work succeeds in shaping the weapon, yet the next chamber reveals that a finished edge and a clean spirit are not the same thing.

events.name: A sacred shore must be approached

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: At Quel’Danas, Halduron Brightwing first refuses the seeker entry to a sacred place recently reclaimed by the blood elves. The Sunwell is no casual road’s end. Its shores carry the memory of a kingdom nearly lost, and trust must be earned before the blade can reach its light. Beyond the Dead Scar, pale stone and red-gold towers frame a question of stewardship: who may bring this dangerous inheritance to the well?

events.name: Lana’thel breaks the blade

date.label: Before the Wrath restoration quest; exact date unknown

events.summary: At Quel’Delar’s Rest, a more recent memory darkens the snow. Lana’thel recounts how the sword passed from Thalorien into her hands after his fall, and how, as the Lich King’s servant, she was ordered to destroy it. She carried Quel’Delar north and broke it here. Her account joins a knight’s last defense to a queen’s enslavement; the broken hilt at the quest’s opening is the remnant of that command.

events.name: Reforged in the Pit of Saron

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: In the Pit of Saron, the quest sets the old blade against saronite: five infused bars and a forgehammer remake its broken length. The mine is a place of forced labor beneath Icecrown, its black ore cut from a frozen wound. This is a player objective, not a separate campaign of named smiths. When the pieces are joined, the sword is whole again—but the material that holds it also carries a peril.

events.name: Orders in the violet city

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: In Dalaran, Caladis Brightspear and Myralion Sunblaze each direct their own faction’s search. Their orders are parallel branches in the quest, not a single council where both factions agree. The city’s pale towers and violet enchantments stand above a contest of memory: each side would restore the old blade, and each expects its own people to guard the inheritance.

events.name: Purified in the Sunwell

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: At last the tempered blade is lowered into the Sunwell. Light passes through the old steel and the saronite taint is cleansed; the quest presents a purified Quel’Delar where the corrupted weapon had rested. The well does not erase Lana’Thel’s command, Thalorien’s sacrifice, or the peril of the halls. It changes what can be carried forward. A weapon once broken and then remade leaves the sacred waters with a new claim upon the living.

events.name: Thalorien at the Sunwell gate

date.label: During the Third War, as the Scourge reached Quel’Thalas; exact date unknown

events.summary: When the Scourge reached Quel’Thalas, Thalorien held the approach before the Sunwell. He fell in that defense, buying time for those behind him; the quest’s memory binds his name to the blade he carried. The golden island was not spared its wound, and the champion was not carried into the future. His stand belongs to the Third War, long before this Wrath quest asks another hand to restore his sword.

events.name: A later trial at Thalorien’s rest

date.label: A later Wrath quest test at the remains of a Third War defender

events.summary: At Thalorien’s resting place, the Wrath quest sets a new seeker against a trial and a memory of the fallen knight. This encounter does not undo his death or make him a living participant in the restoration. His blessing links the blade’s old bearer to its present burden. The story holds both moments apart: Thalorien fell at the Sunwell in the Third War; a later test asks whether the seeker is worthy to carry his memory onward.

events.name: Two courts, one inheritance

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: At Quel’Delar’s Rest, an Alliance seeker answers Caladis Brightspear; a Horde seeker answers Myralion Sunblaze. Their plans pass through separate faction halls, and the player follows one allegiance, not both. In the city’s violet heights, old kinship between high and blood elves cannot settle who may claim the blade. The story keeps both roads visible as alternatives, without giving either branch a universal adventurer.

events.name: Uther names the taint
