date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: Uther’s spirit speaks beside the chamber’s blade: saronite is the blood of an Old God, and the ore has tainted what the hammer restored. His counsel turns the quest toward the Sunwell. No forging technique can cleanse this wound. Beyond the frozen halls lies a place of older light, reclaimed by the blood elves after its earlier fall. There, the sword’s makers’ legacy may be tested against the darkness forced into it.

events.name: A vow to make the blade whole

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The sword’s breaking does not end its history. Myralion vows that the Sunreavers will restore it; Caladis leads the Silver Covenant along its separate path. The two representatives are shown here as a comparative split scene, not as companions sharing one event. Their promise gives purpose to the work ahead: remake the blade, face the will bound within it, and seek a cleansing strong enough to remove what the Scourge has left.

events.name: The blade’s will is subdued

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: The seeker resists the sword’s command and brings its will to heel. Quel’Delar survives the struggle; neither its steel nor the story’s inherited name is discarded. Yet victory in the Halls of Reflection is only restraint. The blade was reforged with the dark ore of Icecrown, and a quieted weapon may still bear the touch of the place that shaped it. A voice from the chamber names the deeper danger.

events.name: Quel'Thalas and the Sunwell Are Founded

date.label: Approximately 6,800 years before the Dark Portal; working chronology

events.summary: The exiles established Quel'Thalas in the northern Eastern Kingdoms and created the Sunwell as the heart of their new civilization.

events.name: Quel'Thalas and the Sunwell Fall

date.label: During the Scourge advance after Lordaeron's fall

events.summary: The Scourge broke Quel'Thalas, raised Sylvanas into undeath, and corrupted the Sunwell while advancing its larger design.

events.name: Quel'Thalas and Arathor Form a Wartime Alliance

date.label: During the Troll Wars

events.summary: Facing an overwhelming Amani assault, Quel'Thalas allied with Arathor and shared limited arcane instruction in exchange for military aid.

events.name: Ragnaros Re-emerges at Blackrock

date.label: At the end of the War of the Three Hammers

events.summary: A desperate Dark Iron summoning brought Ragnaros back into the world, devastated the southern mountains, and ended the dwarven war beneath a new volcanic power.

events.name: A name for the ground

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Quest 5463 identifies Menethil’s Gift as ground blessed by the Lich King and regarded as holy by the Scourge, then directs the seeker to place the keepsake there; secondary quest-page comments locate its sigil in Baron Rivendare’s room.
events.description: Leonid names the place Menethil’s Gift. His explanation gives it a bitter meaning: ground the Lich King blessed, and the Scourge regards as holy. He sends the seeker back to Stratholme with the keepsake. Secondary quest-page comments place the floor sigil in Baron Rivendare’s quarters; that room locator remains unverified against the original client. The quest has turned a rumor into Leonid’s stated memory and a destination.

events.name: A rumor at Light’s Hope

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Quest 5462 directs the seeker to bring the keepsake to Leonid at Light’s Hope and presents Stratholme as the rumored location of Ras’s fall to the Lich King.
events.description: The keepsake is brought to Leonid Barthalomew at Light’s Hope Chapel. Marduke’s next quest calls Stratholme the rumored place of Ras’s surrender, then directs the seeker to the old undead who may know more. A rumor has opened a path, but it has not yet become an established account. At this small timber refuge, the witness is asked to look upon the object and remember.

events.name: A token from life

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Quest 5461 makes a keepsake from Ras’s human years the required basis for attempting to create an artifact that can revert him to mortal form; it does not specify the keepsake’s physical appearance.
events.description: A small possession survives where Ras’s human life once stood. Marduke calls it an opening: the keepsake may let the living make an artifact capable of reaching the lich. The object’s in-game appearance is not specified in the quest account, so the picture here is a symbolic token rather than a recovered item model. The seeker carries it from the ruins toward Light’s Hope.

events.name: An unseen magistrate

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Magistrate Marduke asks the seeker to recover a keepsake from Stromgarde, which he identifies as Ras Frostwhisper’s home, to support an attempt to return Ras to mortal form.
events.description: At Caer Darrow, a magistrate appears only to those who can see the dead. Marduke opens an inquiry into Ras Frostwhisper’s mortal years. A keepsake from Stromgarde, the ruined city he identifies as Ras’s home, may give that history a hold upon the present. The chain’s ghostly access rites are its threshold, not another chapter in Ras’s life. What such a token might restore is not yet known.

events.name: Back to Marduke

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Quest 5465 directs the seeker to return the Soulbound Keepsake to Magistrate Marduke, who is to instruct them in its use.
events.description: The transformed object returns to Caer Darrow. Marduke receives the Soulbound Keepsake and says he will instruct the seeker in its use. The surviving quest text does not preserve those instructions here, so the story takes its action from the next objective instead of supplying ritual details. The course is now set toward Scholomance and the lich whose mortal memory the object carries.

events.name: Leonid explains the bond

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: On quest 5464 completion, Leonid says the soul’s attachment to the keepsake should make it cling to Ras Frostwhisper’s physical form.
events.description: The Soulbound Keepsake returns to Light’s Hope. Leonid says its bond to the fallen soul should also hold to Ras’s physical form. That is his explanation of how the attempt may work, delivered after the item changes. The next task sends the seeker back to Marduke; the chain provides no proof yet that Ras can be restored to life, or that the object can free him permanently.

events.name: Leonid’s memory

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: In quest 5463, Leonid says he witnessed Ras pledge his soul to the Lich King, cut his throat, and become a lich as the Lich King stood over him at Menethil’s Gift.
events.description: Leonid now speaks as an eyewitness. In his account, Ras chose to pledge his soul to the Lich King and cut his own throat; his body fell within the marked ground. Leonid says the Lich King stood over the fallen mage, and Ras rose as a lich. The quest gives this scene to Leonid’s memory, not an independent narrator. His testimony turns the earlier rumor into a named witness account.

events.name: Marduke’s accounting

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: On quest completion, Marduke attributes the deed to ten thousand restless souls and calls it a mortal blow to the Scourge; this is his claim, not an independently verified count or proof that the souls are freed.
events.description: At Caer Darrow, Marduke receives the head and declares that ten thousand restless souls have cried out with the blow dealt to the Scourge. His words measure the meaning he gives the deed; the number is not independently counted in the chain. The ending records a lich made mortal and killed, then a magistrate’s claim. It cannot tell us whether Ras’s own soul is free, or what history follows.

events.name: Mortal again for a moment

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Quest 5466 says use of the Soulbound Keepsake can revert Ras Frostwhisper to mortal form before he is slain; no permanent restoration is recorded.
events.description: The quest’s objective names the change it seeks: if the keepsake succeeds, Ras becomes mortal once more. The scene moves from the undead visage to a human one, enough for the quest’s next act to be carried out. This is a temporary state in an instance encounter, not evidence that Ras’s life is restored or that a lasting cure follows.

events.name: The head returned

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Quest 5466 directs the seeker to kill Ras after the mortal transformation, recover his head, and return it to Marduke.
events.description: Marduke’s instruction is followed by a terrible condition: the mortal Ras must be struck down, and his head brought back. The returned object closes the quest objective; the narration leaves the violence restrained and the result bounded to what the game records. It gives no account of Ras’s spirit afterward, of a lasting freedom from the Scourge, or of other souls departing with him.

events.name: The lich in Scholomance

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Quest 5466 directs the seeker to find Ras Frostwhisper in Scholomance and use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead form.
events.description: The final quest sends the seeker into Scholomance to find Ras Frostwhisper. The old academy’s cold halls frame an encounter with the lich who once chose undeath. No traveling route is drawn across this scene: the dungeon is its own enclosed setting, and the illustration offers no measured floor plan. The keepsake is brought close enough to be used against Ras’s undead form.

events.name: The ruined home

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Quest 5461 identifies ruined Stromgarde as Ras Frostwhisper’s home and directs the seeker to search it for a keepsake from his mortal life; the exact find-location is not fixed by the quest text.
events.description: Stromgarde’s broken stone holds the search. The quest names the keep as Ras’s home and asks for something that belonged to his human life. It does not identify a single room or hearth as the fixed find-site: the item is searched for among the ruins. The journey is an investigation through a fallen city, not a claim that Ras’s mortal story ended here.

events.name: The soulbound keepsake

date.label: Classic quest sequence; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Quest 5464 says the soul of the fallen clings to an object representing its former life, transforming the keepsake into a Soulbound Keepsake; it does not establish that the binding lasts beyond the quest attempt.
events.description: At Menethil’s Gift, the keepsake is set upon the tainted ground. The quest records the change: a soul clings to what recalls its former life, and the object becomes a Soulbound Keepsake. No character is placed beside it in this scene; the transformation is an objective the seeker completes. The quest says what the object becomes, while its lasting effect on Ras remains untested.

events.name: The key and the armies

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: The three recovered fragments returned to the bronze dragon, and the scepter could be made whole. Beyond that personal journey, Horde and Alliance communities were gathering the supplies for a campaign in Silithus. The key alone was not the war effort. Workshops, stores and countless contributions prepared the force that would have to stand before the opened stronghold. Rival peoples worked toward the same threshold, without losing the histories that divided them. The coming battle required both the recovered artifact and the many hands that no single quest could name.

events.name: Blue shard — A dragon who wished to be left alone

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: On Azshara's coast, Azuregos offered a very different account of guardianship. The shard had drawn attention he did not want, interrupting his study of the ancient shore. He had hidden it with an enchanted fish, making an ordinary search of the sea hopeless. His solution for its recovery was an arcanite buoy that would draw the creature out. The instructions lay in a ledger, and the ledger had to be taken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris. The blue trail began with a dragon's evasion and became an engineer's problem.

events.name: Beyond the wall, beneath the temple

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: The campaign continued into the Ruins and the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. Beyond the qiraji armies lay C'Thun, the deeper threat against which the preparations had been gathered. Victory there gave the opened gate its purpose: the company had not restored a key merely to release what waited behind the wall. It had restored a way to reach that danger. The victory brought this campaign to its close, after a long road from the bronze dragon’s vigil. The scepter's legacy joins the losses of the first war to the collective labor of the second.

events.name: Red shard — Beyond the dragon’s suffering

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: The red trail ended with Nefarian's defeat and the recovery of the fragment before it could be destroyed. When it was brought back to Anachronos, the bronze dragon spoke of Vaelastrasz's soul finding rest. The shard was not merely a treasure won from a raid. Its return fulfilled the charge of a guardian whose own strength had failed him. One piece of the scepter was recovered, but the cost of its keeping remained part of the story that the restored artifact would carry.

events.name: Blue shard — The chef and the Isle of Dread

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: Another of Narain's demands led to Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan. The chef's answer sent the adventurers out to the Isle of Dread, off Feralas, to hunt the chimaerok and secure the ingredients for his formidable meal. The scale of the task belonged to the same curious bargain as the goggles: the world's key depended upon satisfying the engineer's requirements. This branch brought the search from desert workshops to a dangerous island, where even preparing a feast called for allies rather than a solitary traveler.

events.name: Blue shard — Libraries, demons, and dragon lairs

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: The missing chapters drew the adventurers through places that rarely belonged to one journey. Pages awaited in Stormwind and Undercity, in the dangerous reaches of Winterspring and the Blasted Lands, and on Doctor Weavil's Alcaz Island. Others required the company to return to Blackwing Lair, confront Onyxia, and reach Ragnaros in Molten Core. A single scattered volume bound these distant dangers to the same unfinished work. The reconstructed volume gave Narain the means to continue the work Azuregos had set before him.

events.name: Green shard — The guardian returns

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: Tyrande's arrival brought the intervention the defenders had awaited. Eranikus was redeemed, and Remulos spoke of his return to the Dream to confront the wrong he had done. The green fragment could now be carried back to Anachronos. Unlike the red trail, this recovery left its guardian able to return to his own work. The two journeys shared a broken scepter, but their endings were different: one honored a lost watcher; the other restored a watcher to the struggle from which he had fallen.

events.name: Green shard — The gathering of corruption

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: Remulos's preparations sent the adventurers to the forest portals associated with the Dream. The search ranged through Duskwood, Ashenvale, Feralas and the Hinterlands, gathering the fragments needed for the next confrontation. These were separate places bound by one danger, rather than a single road across the forest. The journey widened the threat beyond the temple where it had begun. By returning with the corruption's traces, the seekers made possible the attempt to draw Eranikus into Moonglade, where his redemption could be sought.

events.name: Green shard — A guardian lost to the Nightmare

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: The green trail began beneath the marshes, in the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. Near the Shade of Eranikus, Malfurion's appearance directed the search beyond the temple and toward his agent in Teldrassil. From the forest wisp, the road led to Keeper Remulos in Moonglade. The green shard could not be reclaimed by treating its guardian as another enemy to be slain. The search had reached a dragon ensnared by the Nightmare, and the help it sought would have to reach him through that corruption.

events.name: The memory at the Scarab Wall

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: Before seeking the scattered pieces, the adventurers returned to the place where the bond had broken. At the Scarab Wall, the old struggle was shown again: dragons pressing back the qiraji, defenders reaching the barrier, and Fandral turning away from the offered key. This was no new battle in Silithus. It was the past made visible to those who would inherit its unfinished task. The scepter could open a gate; the memory explained why that gate had first been closed, and why its key had been rejected.

events.name: Blue shard — From Silverpine to Molten Core

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: Narain could not turn the ledger into a finished answer without further help. His missing scrying goggles led the seekers to Stewvul, his former friend, hiding in a crate near the Greymane Wall in Silverpine. Stewvul no longer had them: the search continued into Molten Core. Thus a quarrel between gnomes carried the greater quest beneath Blackrock Mountain. The equipment had to be recovered before Narain's work could proceed, binding an apparently small personal errand to the fate of the unopened gates.

events.name: Blue shard — The beast in the Bay of Storms

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: With the preparations complete, the blue trail returned to the sea. Narain sent the adventurers to the Bay of Storms in Azshara with the arcanite buoy, warning them of Maws. The creature that held the shard could be drawn from hiding, but recovering it demanded companions ready for the danger that answered. When the blue fragment was won, the instructions were at last simple: carry it to Anachronos. An old dragon's elaborate concealment had become a journey through much of Azeroth before ending on its storm-bound coast.

events.name: Green shard — Restraint at Nighthaven

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: When Eranikus entered Nighthaven, the duty was to endure him, not to kill him. Keeper Remulos had to survive, and the settlement had to be defended while Tyrande approached. The dragon's assault and the shades of the Nightmare made that restraint costly. Yet destroying him would defeat the purpose for which the defenders had gathered. Their task was to hold the space in which rescue remained possible: to stand against his violence without surrendering the hope that the guardian beneath it could be freed.

events.name: Blue shard — A ransom in the snow

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: The search for Narain's book brought back a ransom letter instead of the missing volume. Its captors demanded payment, and Narain answered with a deception of his own. He gave the adventurers clothing to take his place and a sack of rocks to stand for gold. The appointed meeting lay in Winterspring, far from his desert home. There the false payment brought the seekers into the encounter with Number Two. The scheme did not recover the book; its pages still had to be gathered by another road.

events.name: Flashback · Era 5 — A victory without comfort

date.label: Ancient War of the Shifting Sands

events.summary: At the gate, Merithra, Arygos and Caelestrasz held the enemy back while Anachronos and the defenders raised the barrier. When the seal was made, the bronze dragon offered Fandral a scepter and a gong: a means to open the way if the need returned. Fandral would accept no further burden from that victory. His son was gone; the stronghold still stood. He cast the scepter against the barrier and shattered it. Anachronos gathered the fragments, preserving a duty that grief had refused.

events.name: The road from Cenarion Hold

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: The later journey began in Silithus, where Baristolth of the Shifting Sands directed seekers toward the bronze dragon at the Caverns of Time. Anachronos did not simply place the world's burden in the first hands that reached him. The path demanded evidence of resolve. It led into Blackwing Lair, to Broodlord Lashlayer, before the deeper work of gaining the brood's trust. The task was already larger than one traveler: a champion's progress depended upon companions willing to enter the mountain together.

events.name: Flashback · Era 5 — The war that raised the wall

date.label: Ancient War of the Shifting Sands

events.summary: Long before the adventurers came to Silithus, the night elves had fought a war beneath its harsh southern sky. Fandral Staghelm led their defense against the qiraji, and his son Valstann fell in the struggle. The dragonflights joined the battle, but neither courage nor ancient power could make the loss undone. As the defenders were driven toward Ahn'Qiraj, the question before them became how to contain an enemy they could not wholly destroy. The wall that later generations would find was born of that necessity.

events.name: The gates open

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: When the preparations had brought the campaign to the Scarab Wall, the restored scepter could be raised against the gong. The barrier made by the ancient defenders opened, and the danger it had contained came forth. The ensuing struggle was remembered as the Ten-Hour War. The relic's recovery had not ended the conflict; it had made the confrontation possible. Where Fandral once turned away from the gate in grief, a later generation now stood together before the consequences of opening it.

events.name: Red shard — The captive guardian

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: In Blackwing Lair, Vaelastrasz could no longer fulfill his charge by surrendering the red shard. Nefarian held it, and threatened to destroy it. The wounded red dragon's appeal made the recovery urgent: the loss of that fragment would deny the seekers their key to Ahn'Qiraj. Here the search for an ancient relic entered a living act of cruelty. The adventurers had to carry Vaelastrasz's last request through the fortress of the very enemy who had brought him low.

events.name: The keepers of a broken promise

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: The broken scepter did not pass out of history. Its pieces remained in the keeping of dragons, yet the long vigil brought troubles of its own. When Anachronos later named Eranikus, Vaelastrasz and Azuregos, his warning carried the weight of disappointed trust. Each guardian's story had turned toward tragedy or estrangement. To restore the key, mortal seekers would have to enter those stories. A thousand years separated the wars, but time had not protected the watchers from the wounds of the world.

events.name: The journey that outlived the gong

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: The gong belonged to a brief opening in the campaign, but the quest's final recognition was not identical to that moment. Treasure of the Timeless One remained a distinct conclusion for those who held the restored scepter after the opening war. Remembering that distinction keeps the journey larger than a race for a title. Across forests, libraries, mountains and seas, the work had gathered companions around a broken promise. Its completion remembered the long recovery, as well as the threshold that recovery had allowed the world to cross.

events.name: Blue shard — A book scattered to the winds

date.label: Original WoW Scepter quest journey

events.summary: Narain's missing volume of Draconic for Dummies became another obstacle. Doctor Weavil had intervened, and the book was torn into eight chapters. Narain supplied a magical binding, but the scattered pages had to be found before the volume could be made whole. The search now reached far beyond Tanaris. A text needed to understand the ledger became a second broken object within the greater quest: before the dragon's key could be restored, the engineer's book had to be restored as well.

events.name: The report returns to Darnassus

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Thyn’tel receives the report and calls the account Velinde’s fate. She recalls a trusted friend and accepts that the Scythe has passed out of her people’s hands. Her thanks closes the nine-step chain, but the mystery remains open: the quest does not recover the weapon, identify whoever may have found it, or explain the later fate of every worgen pack. Darnassus can record the loss. It cannot tell the seeker where the Scythe went.

events.name: Containment, not a cure

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Carevin hears the account and does not claim he can end the worgen problem. He will make containing their numbers a priority, while the root of the trouble remains beyond the household’s reach. That is the local resolution the quest supports: a promise to resist a danger, not a cure, a recovered weapon, or a verdict on every cause shaping Duskwood. The trail now returns to Darnassus, where Thyn’tel can hear what the mound revealed.

events.name: No room recorded for Velinde

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Daltry finds no record of Velinde staying at the inn. That silence is limited to the records he knows; it cannot prove she never passed through Darkshire. But when the seeker describes the wolf-men, the clerk has heard of them. He points toward the Carevin household, whose hunters work against monsters in the wood. The search has found no lodging entry and no living witness to Velinde’s arrival. It has found a local lead: a mine to the south where the worgen were first encountered.

events.name: Jitters’s separate testimony

date.label: Separate original World of Warcraft Duskwood witness item; in-world date unknown

events.summary: A separate Duskwood quest path preserves a partial book from Sven’s farm, later connected to Jitters. Its author says he found a scythe in the rubble at Roland’s Doom; after he pulled it free, worgen attacked his companions, and he fled, losing the weapon along the way. He wonders whether his act brought the worgen, but marks that as a guess. This is a witness’s account from another chain, not a guaranteed continuation of Velinde’s investigation. Together the records narrow the loss to Duskwood, yet they do not name the Scythe’s next bearer or prove that it explains every worgen presence in the forest.

events.name: When the summons outlasted its caller

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Later entries darken the triumph. Velinde says the packs grew even when she no longer summoned them; one group sent to range through the forest never returned. She worried that the leaders she had trusted were beyond her control, gathered what worgen she could, and ordered them to remain at the shrine. Her journal then records a search through Darnassus and Darkshore for knowledge, and a rumor that the wizard Arugal had also summoned worgen. It gives her reason to seek him, but does not show that meeting or settle what happened to every pack.

events.name: Ruzzgot remembers the road

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: In Booty Bay, Caravaneer Ruzzgot recalls a night-elf priestess who travelled with his company. They parted on the northbound road, and he remembers her heading for Darkshire. His recollection supplies a lead, not a measured route or a reason for Velinde’s choice. Still, it places her search in Duskwood, where the worgen are already a local fear. The story moves from a ship’s ledger to one person’s memory, and from there to the town records kept by Clerk Daltry.

events.name: A lead east from Darnassus

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Velinde’s final entry says she means to seek passage from a port in the Barrens and follow a lead concerning Arugal. Thyn’tel turns that intention into the seeker’s next task: speak to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet. The quest order traces an investigation; it does not prove every step of Velinde’s own travel or that she ever reached the wizard. One last plan survives in her writing. Beyond it, the trail must be tested against the accounts of people who worked the docks.

events.name: The Black Osprey in the ledger

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: At Ratchet, Dizzywig searches the port ledger and finds Velinde’s name beside passage on the Black Osprey to Booty Bay. With no contrary entry, he assumes the vessel arrived safely. That is a reasonable reading of a dock record, but it is still an inference by the wharfmaster; Velinde leaves no message from the far shore. The harbor narrows the search to a named crossing and a likely destination, then hands the question to a caravaner who may remember what happened after the ship berthed.

events.name: A mine south of Darkshire

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Jonathan Carevin has no record of the elven priestess, but he knows the worgen and the place where they were first found in Duskwood. His family cannot follow every rumor; he asks the seeker to inspect Roland’s Doom and report any sign of the Scythe. The request points toward evidence rather than certainty. The quest does not say that the artifact caused every darkness in the forest, only that the mine may connect the missing weapon with the creatures who appeared there.

events.name: The Scythe’s first purpose

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Velinde writes that the Scythe let her communicate with the worgen and draw them into her world. She says the first pack she summoned followed her against the demons in Felwood. To her, the weapon answered a desperate need: allies for a war her dwindling companions could no longer sustain alone. This is her account of its power and purpose, not an outside chronicle of every battle. Yet it changes the meaning of the pack at Mel’Thandris. The wolf-men are no longer only an unexplained presence; Velinde’s journal says she had summoned worgen in the forest campaign.

events.name: The journal in the bunkhouse

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: The Tome and Melyria’s report persuade Thyn’tel to lend the key to Velinde’s chest in the Sentinels’ bunkhouse. The search yields a journal, not a final explanation. Its entries are Velinde’s own record of her work and her doubts, written without dates that would fix the events on a calendar. What follows is an attributed account: it tells us what Velinde believed she had done with the Scythe, while leaving room for what one witness could not see.

events.name: A voice beneath the mound

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: At a mound of earth inside Roland’s Doom, Velinde’s specter appears. Her words convey failure, worgen beyond control, and the loss of Elune’s Scythe; she wonders whose hand now directs its power. The scene lets the seeker hear her grief, but it does not show the moment of her death or name a new bearer. The mine has yielded the missing priestess’s testimony and confirmed that the artifact is no longer with her. Its path after that loss remains unseen.

events.name: The wolf-men of the Howling Vale

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: At Forest Song, Melyria measures the sentinels’ work against a forest that will not quiet. Her report speaks of the struggle against demons pressing out of Felwood, while a ruined shrine near the northern border has been overtaken by mysterious wolf-men. Their cries have given the hollow its name. She asks the seeker to read the Tome of Mel’Thandris and learn what may have drawn them there. That is the first question the Classic chain sets before us: a sacred ruin, a strange pack, and a record whose workings no one fully understands.

events.name: A memory in Mel’Thandris

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: At the shrine, the Tome answers by showing a remembered scene. Velinde Starsong calls to Elune as her companions dwindle and her own strength falters against the demons. In the vision, she receives the Scythe of Elune and regards it as an answer to her prayer. Melyria says the image leaves more to investigate. The quest does not make the Tome’s nature plain, and this first scene does not yet show how the gift will alter the danger in the forest.

events.name: A trusted Sentinel is missing

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest-chain scene; in-world date unknown

events.summary: Melyria sends the inquiry to Thyn’tel Bladeweaver in Darnassus. Velinde had served before Melyria at Forest Song, and her disappearance has left the Sentinels without an answer. Thyn’tel is reluctant to expose her belongings to a stranger; the priestess had earned the trust of her people, who still expect her to return. The quest supplies no calendar date for this absence. The search begins between two records: a vision at the ruined shrine and a city that has kept Velinde’s effects in the hope she might come home.

events.name: The Second War Begins

date.label: After the formation of the Alliance of Lordaeron

events.summary: The Horde drove north while the newly formed Alliance organized a defense across several kingdoms and theaters.

events.name: The Covenant Campaigns Converge

date.label: During the Shadowlands campaign

events.summary: Champions worked among distinct covenant realms whose campaigns formed the broad framework of resistance in the afterlife.

events.name: A fount for a new home

date.label: Era 5 prologue · before the Burning Crusade

events.summary: Long before this campaign, exiles from Kalimdor crossed to the northern Eastern Kingdoms and made Quel’Thalas their home. There, at a convergence of arcane power, they raised the Sunwell. Its waters became a center of their new nation and a source the blood elves would later struggle to live without. The people built their home around the fount, and all that followed would be measured against its loss.

events.name: A sacred water defiled

date.label: Era 7 prologue · the Third War

events.summary: When the Scourge reached Quel’Thalas, its advance ended in ruin for the kingdom. Arthas Menethil corrupted the Sunwell in the course of that invasion. The fount that had sustained the high elves was lost, leaving the surviving blood elves to seek other ways through their hunger for magic. Its loss cast a long shadow across the years ahead.

events.name: Anveena’s choice

date.label: The Burning Crusade · final raid encounter

events.summary: As Kil’jaeden threatens to break through, Anveena turns her power against him. Her sacrifice weakens the demon, and the attackers drive him from the well. The light she gives is spent; still, taint remains in the waters below.

events.name: Brutallus and Madrigosa

date.label: The Burning Crusade · second raid encounter

events.summary: Above the Dead Scar, Madrigosa challenges Brutallus. The pit lord strikes the blue dragon down, and her fall dims the defenders’ hopes. Yet the fel blood spilled from Brutallus will not leave her body in peace.

events.name: Felmyst rises

date.label: The Burning Crusade · third raid encounter

events.summary: From Brutallus’s wound, fel blood spreads beneath Madrigosa and stirs the fallen dragon once more. She rises as Felmyst, her blue form emptied of its old grace and wreathed in green fire. The cost of the battle follows the attackers deeper into the plateau.

events.name: Kael’thas at the Terrace

date.label: The Burning Crusade · parallel island operation

events.summary: Elsewhere on the isle, the Shattered Sun confronts Kael’thas within Magisters’ Terrace. His stand ends there; at the plateau, the Sunwell remains beneath his design. The prince is stopped, yet the fount itself is still in danger.

events.name: Kalecgos under control

date.label: The Burning Crusade · first raid encounter

events.summary: At the edge of the inner sanctum, Sathrovarr holds Kalecgos in thrall. The blue dragon fights from within a shadowed realm even as allies face the dreadlord outside. When his captor’s hold breaks, Kalecgos is free to lend his strength to the defense.

events.name: Kil’jaeden crosses the well

date.label: The Burning Crusade · final raid encounter

events.summary: At the last chamber, Kil’jaeden rises from the Sunwell, and the portal he sought begins to take shape. Kalecgos and the blue dragonflight join the defense around the threatened fount. Only Anveena’s act can break the demon’s advance.

events.name: M’uru and Entropius

date.label: The Burning Crusade · fifth raid encounter

events.summary: Within the Shrine of the Eclipse, the Offensive reaches M’uru, the naaru taken from Silvermoon. Its light has darkened into Entropius, and the defenders are forced to destroy the captive they had hoped to save. A spark endures within the heart that remains.

events.name: The heart renews the Sunwell

date.label: The Burning Crusade · original raid epilogue

events.summary: Velen arrives with Lady Liadrin and recovers the spark that remains in M’uru’s heart. He turns it upon the tainted water, and the Sunwell shines again, bearing both arcane light and the naaru’s gift. Liadrin grieves for what the Blood Knights did to M’uru; Velen answers with hope for what may grow from the loss. The old danger is ended, while the future of the nation is left open.

events.name: Outland supports the campaign

date.label: The Burning Crusade · parallel offensive activity

events.summary: The Offensive’s work reached back into Outland as well. Bands struck Sunfury holdings and gathered what the campaign needed, while other soldiers held the island front. Each force bore its own burden beneath the broken sky, far from the shore of Quel’Danas.

events.name: Shattrath stands together

date.label: The Burning Crusade · Shattered Sun Offensive

events.summary: In Shattrath, blood elves and draenei joined the Shattered Sun Offensive against Kael’thas and the Legion. The coalition crossed old divisions to confront a threat aimed at Quel’Thalas. Heroes of the Horde and Alliance also took part; together, they turned toward the endangered fount.

events.name: A shorehead on Quel’Danas

date.label: The Burning Crusade · patch 2.4 campaign

events.summary: The first position on the island is small and exposed. The Offensive arrives with limited forces near the Sunwell Plateau, where blood elves aligned with Kael’thas and demons hold the way inward. From that shorehead, the scattered coalition begins to press the island and its guarded approach.

events.name: The Deceiver is driven back

date.label: The Burning Crusade · raid victory

events.summary: The heroes banish Kil’jaeden from the fount and stop the summoning before the Legion can pour through. The immediate invasion is ended. Yet the Sunwell’s waters remain polluted, and the blood elves face a second peril: the loss of the fount around which their kingdom gathered.

events.name: The paired warlocks

date.label: The Burning Crusade · fourth raid encounter

events.summary: Lady Sacrolash and Grand Warlock Alythess stand together before the deeper halls. Their crimson and violet powers guard the way toward M’uru. Together, the Eredar Twins form one last wall between the Offensive and the fount.

events.name: The island front opens

date.label: The Burning Crusade · patch 2.4 gameplay phases

events.summary: Across the sanctum, armory and harbor, the coalition presses against Kael’thas’s banners. Farther off, a portal opens toward Shattrath, widening the reach of the island front. Each gain brings the defenders nearer to the plateau and the fount they guard.

events.name: The missing contact

date.label: The Burning Crusade · Magisters’ Terrace quest path

events.summary: An intelligence contact inside Magisters’ Terrace stops reporting. The Shattered Sun sends a search party into the blood-elf complex to find the missing spy and recover what they learned. Within those polished halls, the campaign meets another face of Kael’thas’s rule.

events.name: The plateau breach

date.label: The Burning Crusade · Sunwell Plateau raid

events.summary: Beyond the island’s outer battles lies Sunwell Plateau, where Kael’thas has turned the fount toward his summoning. Demons and corrupted light gather around the heart of Quel’Thalas. The defenders must cross the high sanctum and reach the well itself.

events.name: The prince returns

date.label: The Burning Crusade · exact in-world date unknown

events.summary: After his defeat in Outland, Kael’thas returned to Silvermoon. He betrayed the people he had promised to lead and turned toward a new design: using the Sunwell to summon Kil’jaeden. Thus the fount became an immediate danger once more, and an inheritance the blood elves could not reclaim.

events.name: A victory with a danger left

date.label: The Burning Crusade · after the raid battle

events.summary: Kil’jaeden is gone, yet corruption still clouds the Sunwell. Regent Lord Lor’themar considers destroying it lest the sickness spread beyond the fount. A victory has spared Quel’Thalas from one catastrophe, but the price may yet be the heart of the kingdom. Then Velen comes to honor M’uru.

events.name: Two calls to the Isle

date.label: The Burning Crusade · patch 2.4 quest entry

events.summary: From Shattrath came two calls to the isle’s work. Aldor agents sent the seeker north with “Crisis at the Sunwell,” while the Scryers offered “Duty Calls.” The choice began on opposite sides of the Terrace of Light, yet both led across the sea toward Quel’Danas and the staging ground near the fount.

events.name: Shattrath Falls to the Horde

date.label: Near the culmination of the Horde's war against the draenei

events.summary: The Horde's assault devastated Shattrath and broke the principal center of organized draenei resistance, though draenei survivors endured.

events.name: The Siege Ends Garrosh's Rule

events.summary: Opposition from within and beyond the Horde converged on Orgrimmar and ended Garrosh Hellscream's rule.

events.name: The Primordial Imbalance

date.label: Before the arrival of the Old Gods

events.summary: As Azeroth's world-soul developed, it consumed much of the fifth element, Spirit, leaving the native elementals without its balancing influence.
events.description: This descriptive event record captures the source account’s causal explanation for the violent state of primordial Azeroth's elementals.

events.name: Stormwind Falls

date.label: At the end of the First War

events.summary: The Horde captured and devastated Stormwind, forcing surviving leaders and refugees to flee north.

events.name: Stratholme Is Purged

events.summary: Convinced Stratholme's people were infected, Arthas ordered the city purged; Jaina and Uther rejected the course, deepening his isolation.

events.name: The Sunwell Becomes the Darkwell

date.label: During the Voidspire confrontation

events.summary: Xal’atath channels Void power into the Sunwell, transforming it into the Darkwell as Alleria and Turalyon vanish into its depths.
events.description: The timeline records their disappearance, not a confirmed ultimate fate.

events.name: Thoradin Unites Arathor

date.label: Approximately 2,800 years before the Dark Portal; working chronology

events.summary: Thoradin brought scattered human tribes beneath one banner and established Arathor around the fortified center of Strom.

events.name: Thrall Liberates Interned Orcs

date.label: Nearly thirteen years after the Horde's defeat

events.summary: Thrall freed orcs from internment and gathered a new Horde whose purpose was not identical to the conquered Old Horde.

events.name: A family restored in paint

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The returned painting brings Karandra and young Taelan into view beside Tirion. The Classic quest connects it to family outings and a portrait made by Renfray; the lakeside colors here interpret that recollection rather than claim an exact beach or the canvas’s original appearance. The painting restores a likeness, not a lost childhood. For Tirion, memory can now be given back in a form his son may recognize, if the son is still willing to receive it.

events.name: A gift beneath Scarlet colors

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: A disguise opens the way into Hearthglen, where Tirion’s gift can reach Taelan. The Classic chain makes subterfuge the bridge between father and son: the seeker enters the Scarlet Crusade’s stronghold under borrowed colors and gives the package to its Highlord. The banners and pale stone of the settlement frame a tense reunion without placing Tirion there. The audience sees the old family tokens cross a guarded threshold; what Taelan will do with them remains his choice.

events.name: A vow to rebuild the Silver Hand

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: At Taelan’s body, Tirion vows to gather a new Order of the Silver Hand and turn it again toward the defense of the world. The Classic chain ends with a purpose, not with the later history of that order already fulfilled. A small emblem rests beside the grieving father as a visual echo of the honor Taelan once laid down. The quest closes Tirion and Taelan’s story here; later campaigns, including the Wrath-era chapters, belong to their own records.

events.name: The road ends at the tower

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Beyond Hearthglen, the quest brings Taelan to a roadside tower and Grand Inquisitor Isillien. It records Taelan’s death there at Isillien’s hands. The story does not soften this into a mere interruption: the son who chose to leave the Scarlet Crusade has no return to the father he hoped to meet. The tower stands at the edge of the road, a small human post amid a wounded land, and the long effort to restore memory reaches its cost.

events.name: Myranda at Uther’s Tomb

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The keepsakes travel onward as a message to Myranda, whom the chain locates at Uther’s Tomb. Tirion asks his former ally to help the seeker pass into Hearthglen. Myranda’s brief place in this story reaches back to her work alongside him, though this quest does not retell every part of her life. Against pale memorial stone and plague-damaged grass, she becomes the last guide before the family’s past is carried directly to Taelan.

events.name: Out through Hearthglen

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Taelan leaves the keep and makes his way out through Hearthglen. The quest turns this departure into an ordeal as Scarlet Crusade forces oppose him. He is no longer the quiet child Tirion watched from exile: he has chosen to break with the order that shaped his adult life. The guards become a last barrier between the Highlord and the open road. The chain gives no private motive to each soldier, and Taelan’s struggle ends at the tower beyond the settlement.

events.name: Renfray remembers Caer Darrow

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Tirion’s memory turns from the marks of duty to family excursions and an artist’s work. He sends the seeker to Caer Darrow, where his old friend Artist Renfray remains among the ruins. She painted the Fordring family in happier days. The island is now a quiet ruin in the lake, and Renfray is a ghost; the quest asks for a portrait, not a return to the life it preserves. Across years of exile, the canvas is a rare piece of the family’s past that has not vanished.

events.name: Taelan ends the dream

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The gift reaches the part of Taelan that his title could not silence. In the quest account, he recognizes how long he has been made a tool of the Grand Crusader, and his father’s memory has endured beneath that service. Taelan decides to leave Hearthglen. The portrait and keepsakes do not command him; they return a past from which he can make a choice of his own. The hall’s red-and-white standards still surround him, but their claim on his future has broken.

events.name: A small hammer beneath a false grave

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: A miniature warhammer, once given to Taelan by his father, lies in the Undercroft. The reproduced quest account connects it to a false grave and to the story Taelan had been told as a child: that Tirion was dead. The object is small enough for a young hand, but it carries the weight of an absence made permanent by a lie. Its recovery does not undo the years apart. It gives Tirion one remembered gift to place before his son.

events.name: The old hermit by Thondroril

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: In the cold reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands, an old hermit accepts help before he offers his name. The early errands are practical work among the dangers of the plague-struck countryside; they prove only that a stranger can be trusted. The narration begins at the bank where the hermit waits, after those tasks have opened his story. They did not cause his exile, and they are not recast here as a single battle. Beyond the river, a family’s long absence is the wound still waiting to be named.

events.name: The emblem in Northdale’s lake

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Tirion next asks for a symbol Taelan left behind. The quest recalls his son’s stand at Northdale after Uther’s death and says Taelan laid down the Silver Hand standard; its emblem now lies beneath the lake. The record preserves a moment of disillusion, not a full account of the fighting. We do not invent an exact battlefield line or name the soldiers who stood with him. The small sign of the old order rises from dark water, ready to join the hammer as a piece of shared history.

events.name: The portrait behind the twin moons

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Renfray’s follow-up bears the same title as the task that brought the seeker to her, yet it is a different Classic quest. Its objective leads into Stratholme, where the family painting is hidden behind a picture of twin moons in the Archivist’s room. The crimson city has become a storehouse of other people’s ruin; within it, a small work of family memory survives. This scene shows the concealment as an original interpretation, not an exact dungeon plan or verified painting model.

events.name: Tirion arrives

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: Tirion reaches the tower too late to save his son. The quest account then has him defeat Isillien and grieve beside Taelan. The father’s return answers the appeal he made at Thondroril, but not in the way he sought: he has recovered the truth and lost the living voice that might have answered him. We hold the scene to those recorded actions. No dialogue is reconstructed, and the art does not invent a private final exchange.

events.name: The father in exile

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic · Tirion and Taelan quest chain; exact dating unknown

events.summary: The hermit names himself Tirion Fordring. The quest account says that he was convicted of treason and banished from the Alliance; it does not explain the charge’s full history. He chose to remain in exile near his son. Taelan became lord of Mardenholde and later a Highlord of the Scarlet Crusade, an order Tirion sees as fallen from the Silver Hand’s purpose. Tirion asks for help because he believes his son can still remember the honor they once shared.

events.name: The Titan-forged Are Mustered

events.name: Ancient Allies Join the Defense

events.summary: Cenarius and other powers of ancient Kalimdor joined the defense, while the Dragon Aspects prepared a weapon intended to drive back the Legion.

date.label: During the healing of Azeroth

events.summary: The keepers established complementary facilities in the far north and south to stabilize Azeroth and sustain the work of ordering it.
